metadata.question: Did the area around Windhoek, Nambia appear greener on February 7, 2021 as compared to the same region on January 29, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use Sentinel-2 for both dates (Feb 7, 2021 and Jan 29, 2020) around Windhoek, Namibia. Sentinel-2 has good temporal coverage and NDVI is reliable for greenness assessment. 2. Masking strategy: Apply cloud masking (SCL band) to get clean observations, as cloud cover can affect NDVI measurements. 3. Logic: Calculate mean NDVI for each date. Compare: if NDVI(Feb 2021) > NDVI(Jan 2020), answer A (Yes, greener). If NDVI(Feb 2021) <= NDVI(Jan 2020), answer B (No). data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
windhoek_coords = [17.0832, -22.5597]  # Longitude, Latitude
windhoek_geom = ee.Geometry.Point(windhoek_coords).buffer(5000)  # 5 km buffer

date1_start = '2020-01-20'
date1_end = '2020-02-07'
date2_start = '2021-01-31'
date2_end = '2021-02-14'

# 2. Data Acquisition - Jan 29, 2020
col1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') \
    .filterBounds(windhoek_geom) \
    .filterDate(date1_start, date1_end) \
    .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30))

if col1.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No Sentinel-2 data for Jan 2020. Trying alternative approach...")
    col1 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') \
        .filterBounds(windhoek_geom) \
        .filterDate(date1_start, date1_end) \
        .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30))

size1 = col1.size().getInfo()
print(f"Jan 2020 Images: {size1}")

if size1 == 0:
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # Calculate NDVI for Jan 2020
    def add_ndvi_s2(img):
        ndvi = img.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI')
        return img.addBands(ndvi)
    
    def mask_clouds_s2(img):
        scl = img.select('SCL')
        mask = scl.neq(3).And(scl.neq(8)).And(scl.neq(9)).And(scl.neq(10))
        return img.updateMask(mask)
    
    col1_processed = col1.map(mask_clouds_s2).map(add_ndvi_s2)
    img1 = col1_processed.select('NDVI').median()
    
    count1 = img1.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=windhoek_geom,
        scale=30,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('NDVI').getInfo()
    
    ndvi1 = img1.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=windhoek_geom,
        scale=30,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('NDVI').getInfo()
    
    print(f"Jan 2020 NDVI: {ndvi1:.4f} (Pixels: {int(count1) if count1 else 0})")
    
    if count1 == 0 or ndvi1 is None:
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    else:
        # Data Acquisition - Feb 7, 2021
        col2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') \
            .filterBounds(windhoek_geom) \
            .filterDate(date2_start, date2_end) \
            .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30))
        
        if col2.size().getInfo() == 0:
            col2 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') \
                .filterBounds(windhoek_geom) \
                .filterDate(date2_start, date2_end) \
                .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30))
        
        size2 = col2.size().getInfo()
        print(f"Feb 2021 Images: {size2}")
        
        if size2 == 0:
            print("<answer>C1</answer>")
        else:
            col2_processed = col2.map(mask_clouds_s2).map(add_ndvi_s2)
            img2 = col2_processed.select('NDVI').median()
            
            count2 = img2.reduceRegion(
                reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
                geometry=windhoek_geom,
                scale=30,
                maxPixels=1e9
            ).get('NDVI').getInfo()
            
            ndvi2 = img2.reduceRegion(
                reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
                geometry=windhoek_geom,
                scale=30,
                maxPixels=1e9
            ).get('NDVI').getInfo()
            
            print(f"Feb 2021 NDVI: {ndvi2:.4f} (Pixels: {int(count2) if count2 else 0})")
            
            if count2 == 0 or ndvi2 is None:
                print("<answer>C2</answer>")
            elif ndvi1 is None or ndvi2 is None:
                print("<answer>C3</answer>")
            else:
                ndvi_diff = ndvi2 - ndvi1
                print(f"NDVI Difference (Feb 2021 - Jan 2020): {ndvi_diff:.4f}")
                
                if ndvi2 > ndvi1:
                    print("<answer>A</answer>")
                else:
                    print("<answer>B</answer>")
